summary: Worker-2/4/6 source review recovered supported antiviral and viability rows from XML/PDF/supplement text, reconciled linked DRAMP rows with a sequence-modification caution, bounded the mechanism to source-located PS/envelope evidence, and closed the prior framework-only rework ticket.
adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 source review recovered supported antiviral and viability rows from XML/PDF/supplement text, reconciled linked DRAMP rows with a sequence-modification caution, bounded the mechanism to source-located PS/envelope evidence, and closed the prior framework-only rework ticket.

notes: XML/PDF text and figure captions contain the exact text-reported antiviral values used for final rows.
Supplementary PDF text contains the categorical virus-family screen and cell-viability figure captions; no spreadsheet-style supplementary table exists locally.
Figure-only dose curves without text-exact intermediate values were not digitized because the gate-relevant exact maxima and categorical effects were available from local text.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: The linked DRAMP activity/experiment rows match primary antiviral values after source review but remain sequence_modified_not_normalized because the primary experimental peptide is N-biotinylated, C-amidated, and contains cysteine-to-Abu replacements not represented in DRAMP fields.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final activity/toxicity rows now preserve source-supported antiviral inhibition, categorical no-effect virus findings, and mammalian-cell viability evidence with XML/PDF/supplement locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are bounded to direct virion pretreatment, PS lipid interaction, and PS-vesicle leakage evidence; TAP inhibition is retained only as parent-protein origin context.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_4_publication_grade: No blocking owner-layer rework remains after bounded local source review; remaining caveats are conflict-preserving curation notes, not open rework tickets.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DRAMP30344 stores the unmodified CPXV012 parent segment and free termini, while the primary experimental peptide is reported with N-terminal biotin, C-terminal amide, and cysteine-to-Abu replacement.

Intermediate per-dose curve values are figure-only in local material; exact text-reported maximum values and categorical screen outcomes were extracted and are sufficient for final row-level curation.
